title: Finding the Whole Given a Part and a Percent

items.prompt: 20% of a number is 14. What is the number?
50% of a number is 32. What is the number?
items.rationale: If 32 is half the number, the whole number is 32 x 2 = 64.

items.prompt: 25% of a number is 9. What is the number?
If you know the percent and the part, how do you find the whole?

choices.A: whole = part x percent (as a decimal)

items.rationale: Since part = whole x percent, dividing both sides by the percent gives whole = part / percent.

items.prompt: A student answered 18 questions correctly, which was 75% of the test. How many total questions were on the test?

ixl_prep.label: Find the total given a part and a percent
